authorized_offline_repair.scope: Repair only the local pinned-image manifest-size parser. Accept the registry schema variants returned for the exact digest, sum every referenced compressed layer size without trusting mutable tags, and fail closed on a missing, malformed, duplicate, negative, or non-integer size.
authorized_offline_repair.positive_fixture: A content-bound exact-digest manifest with config and layer descriptors must yield a deterministic total byte count and sufficient-space decision.
authorized_offline_repair.negative_fixtures: Missing size, schema mismatch, digest mismatch, duplicate descriptor, and malformed numeric values must fail closed before any provider creation.
authorized_offline_repair.terminal: Persist REPAIR_READY.json with the repaired source hash, exact positive/negative fixture hashes and results, original endpoint identities, and provider_mutated=false.

provider_gate.replacement_geometry: A fresh provider resource with a director-selected 200-GiB risk-reduction geometry may be created and registered only after REPAIR_READY.json passes. The failed parser did not establish a physical minimum.

forbidden: changing the image, model, runtime, workload, or scientific contract
marking endpoint consumption before the first endpoint request is submitted

budgets.future_provider_deadline: Director must choose an absolute deadline after the offline gate passes and keep total exposure within the cumulative authorization.
